title: Sports and Arts
intro: Sports, physical education, painting, music, dance and theatre.

nodes.label: Music, dance or theatre classes
nodes.note: Join classes and take grade exams. Many universities offer a BA in Music, Dance or Theatre by marks or audition.

nodes.label: BPEd or Sports Science
nodes.note: 2 to 4 years. Train to coach and teach.

nodes.label: BFA or BVA (fine arts)
nodes.note: 3 to 4 years of painting, sculpture and applied art.

nodes.label: BA in Music, Dance or Theatre
Athlete
nodes.note: Compete for your school, state and country.

nodes.label: Coach or PE teacher
nodes.note: Train players and teach sport in schools.

nodes.label: Sports scientist or physiotherapist
nodes.note: Help athletes get fit and recover.

nodes.label: Musician, dancer or actor
nodes.note: Perform on stage, screen or online.
